rq.q: A Fairy Tale I - Growing Pains

m.post:
Drinking a dose of harvest potion allows farmers to harvest enriched produce when harvesting from allotment patches. A single dose of harvest potion costs 936 gp which lasts 6 minutes. The same level of farming is required for both normal and enriched produce, with enriched produce being used in the creation of primal feasts.

Harvesting from allotment patches yields between 3 and 56 produce per plot, the recommended boosts below increase the maximum yield beyond 56. This moneymaker is using an average of 50 per plot to account for the range of yields you'll likely receive. If you're using all of the boosts and all plots survive, harvesting 350+ is quite common.

Boosts to yield

  1. Master farmer outfit gives a 10% chance to harvest more crops
  2. Supercompost, ultracompost, and Fertile Soil increases the amount of produce
  3. Magic secateurs grants an increase in yield from allotments - approximately 12.5% more at 99 Farming

m.h:
The number of runs per hour may be higher or lower depending on the teleports available to you, whether you have (Bladed) Dive/Mobile, how much attention you pay to the game, and whether you are using The Light Within trick.

Mjolnirs can be hunted for again after completion of the enchanted key lore activity. To be eligible, the player must not own any mjolnirs or the enchanted key. There are two ways that can be achieved: using the drop trick to trick Jorral into thinking we aren't in possession of any mjolnirs, or by starting The Light Within and not completing the section that requires you to use the enchanted key because it allows you to obtain a key even if you already have a mjolnir. The order of mjolnirs is always the same (Guthix, Saradomin, then Zamorak).

  • Teleport to the Outpost with a traveller's necklace (2), talk to Jorral
  • (Guthix) Archaeology journal teleport, run south-west.
  • (Saradomin) Teleport to the Skills necklace north of Crafting Guild, go north-east.
  • (Zamorak) Teleport to Het's Oasis via a ring of duelling (1), go north-west.
  • Use magic notepaper on the Saradomin, Zamorak mjolnir, and Guthix mjolnir.
    • You may also drop/disassemble the Saradomin and Guthix mjolnir because of their low guide prices.
  • Repeat, but drop your stacks of mjolnirs before talking to Jorral, then pick them up afterwards.
    • If you are using The Light Within trick, you do not have to note/drop the mjolnirs.

The Guthix mjolnirs are not worth noting due to their low value, so it is recommended to drop or disassemble them. Due to slow sale rates on the Grand Exchange, gold per hour may vary.

1 2 3 4 5 6 7               This is a recommended action bar, giving an easier access to all the items. Surge/Escape ability can replace Dive/Bladed Dive for players without either dive ability unlocked.

Money and time can be saved by using the individual teleport items instead of a passage of the abyss, preferably if they're compacted, but this requires 110 Invention and extra invention components.

m.pg: Money making guide/Fishing a divine rocktail bubble

rq.h: Other participants who have 90+ fishing

m.h:
Note: this guide is written to reflect the placer of the bubble with a 5 person+ group. If you are a participant, you can expect to profit around 18180 coins as there will be no input costs.

Raw rocktails are in demand both because of the good Cooking experience they give and because of the high-tier healing power their cooked variant gives. Rocktail bubbles last for long enough to give 20 – 28 rocktails per person. With other participants, you will almost definitely reach your cap of around 60 rocktails (depending on your total level).

Once daily, a player may create one divine location of any kind. In addition to this, the player has a limit on how much they may harvest from any divine location. This limit is almost always reached from a single divine rocktail bubble with 5 other people. The time for creating and harvesting from divine locations resets every day at 00:00 UTC.

rq.q: A Fairy Tale II - Cure a Queen

rq.h: The Elder Kiln (recommended) for TokKul-Zo

m.h:
Access to fairy rings is strongly recommended as both the fishing spots for raw karambwanji (which are untradeable and required to catch karambwan) and raw karambwan are very close to fairy rings and otherwise remote.

Teleport to fairy ring with a karambwan vessel, which is just south of the raw karambwanji fishing spot. Do not bring a Beast of Burden as they cannot carry karambwanji. There are level 28 hobgoblins around that are aggressive to players under level 56. You may catch one or two raw shrimps along with them. Discard those. You may load a single raw karambwanji into the vessel to carry one more, but you will have to drop it first at the karambwan spot to start catching until one of them steals the bait.

Once you have a full inventory of raw karambwanji, teleport to fairy ring . Catching karambwan is almost instant but very click intensive. You must left click on the raw karambwanji, then use it on the vessel to load it, and then on the fishing spot for every catch. Additionally, when the vessel is emptied of karambwanji, it is automatically placed at the first available empty slot in your inventory, after the karambwan it just caught, which makes it move around a lot and tedious to click.

Using fairy rings and banking with TokKul-Zo and with some practice, one trip takes about 4 minutes. Some karambwan may steal your bait without being caught. The profit assumes 25 per inventory.

Using a tackle box daily can be very helpful for making more money with this method with the tele-bank option up to 500 fish per day. It also extends each bank trip with its storage.

m.pg: Money making guide/Fletching elder headless arrows
m.h:
Always make sure to check prices before you invest heavily into the method.

Cut the Elder logs into Elder arrow shafts, then combine them with Feathers to create Elder headless arrows.

Using a Fletching cape provides a 0.75% chance to make extra arrows. Using a Portable fletcher provides a 10% chance to save arrowheads and headless arrows when making arrows. A tier 2 Ranger's Workroom has a 1% chance to fletch an extra bundle of these arrow shafts and headless arrows. Crystal knife provides a 5% double these arrow shafts.

Due to the buy limit of Feathers being 100,000 (compared to the buy limit of Elder logs being 25,000), it is suggested to put in a large order of Feathers so they buy slowly while you cut the Elder logs into Elder arrow shafts. Be warned that prices can fluctuate over a long period of time, so profitability may increase or decrease depending on the costs.

Headless arrows are made by using feathers on arrow shafts, and they are used in Fletching to create arrows for quick experience gains. Because most fletchers will not create the headless arrows on their own, there is an opportunity for low-level players to make a fair amount of profit (and decent experience) by fletching headless arrows.

To start with, test the profit of making one headless arrow -- buy one feather and one arrow shaft from the Grand Exchange, make a headless arrow, and sell it. If the profit is less than 10, there may be better options to make money. If it is higher, buy up feathers and arrow shafts in bulk. It may be more profitable to purchase or even chop logs to make the shafts, however that would also require additional time.

To create headless arrows you need the arrow shafts and feathers in your inventory. Left click on the arrow shafts, then click "Fletch" (or space bar) to make 60 sets of 15 arrow shafts automatically, taking about 72 seconds. You can make 45,000 headless arrows an hour if you have enough materials. However, feathers and arrow shafts have a buying limit of 100,000 every four hours, so you can only buy about 130 minutes worth of headless arrow materials per four hours. It may be useful to put in an overnight offer for feathers and arrow shafts if you have enough money to start with. You can buy more feathers at fishing shops (around 1,000 per 24 hours per shop).

Because making headless arrows does not require banking and only takes up three inventory spaces, it can be used in conjunction with other moneymaking methods where there is a long wait between actions. This includes collecting cave nightshade, cave goblin wire, and potato cactus. For F2P players, Grapes (7,221 gp) at the Cooks' Guild or Red spiders eggs (185 gp) in the Varrock Sewers can be good.

To find the current location of a Portable fletcher, ask in the "portables" Friends chat.

The perk from the Fletching cape and the tier 2 and 3 of the Ranger's Workroom grant 0.75% and 1% chance to make an extra bundle of headless dinarrows with every action, respectively. However, a portable fletcher doesn't provide any benefit when making headless dinarrows.

Even though headless dinarrows don't use feathers, the "Headless Chicken" perk from having hens placed in a pen in the player-owned farm grants 3% to 5% chance to save half of the dinosaur 'propellant' used with each action. This can help save up to 1,200 dinosaur 'propellant' out of 45,000 normally used per hour, increasing hourly profit.

Due to the buy limit of the ingredients being lower than what you can produce in an hour, you may need to buy from other players or leave in GE offers overnight or longer.

m.t: Generating compost with a compost mound familiar (Normal account)
m.pg: Money making guide/Generating compost with a compost mound familiar

rq.h: Buckets All the Way Down upgrade from Sydekix's Shop of Balance

m.h:
It's recommended to complete this method in Taverley, just north of the Player-owned house portal, where the Tool leprechaun stands right next to the compost bin. The tool leprechaun at this location will also never move from his position. Each use of the scroll requires 12 special move points, which regenerate back normally in slightly less than 22 seconds, allowing the player to use approximately 167 scrolls per hour without the use of any special move boosting effects. A compost mound familiar lasts 36 minutes without any extensions.

Buckets All the Way Down upgrade allows players to draw compost from the compost bin without requiring any buckets, and is therefore ultimately required for maximum profit and uptime. This can be bought at Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 10,000 Crux Eqal favour.

When the special move bar is regenerating, you should take compost from the bin and right-click 'Exchange' with the tool leprechaun to store all the compost with him, you may then right click the stored buckets to withdraw them in noted form at any point. The compost bin will hold a maximum of 1000 processed compost of each type, so it is not possible to do an entire hour without drawing any buckets from the bin.

The amounts of compost and super compost are slightly random, as the scroll generates super compost instead at about 1 in 10 times, but both types are generated 15 at a time. The Compost Mound familiar will also generate compost and super compost into its inventory every once in a while, which can be withdrawn for slightly more profit in total.

m.h:
__NOTOC__ This assumes 60 deliveries per hour buying all requests from the grand exchange. Note you must buy the non-premade variants in order for the delivery to be accepted.

To start Gnome Restaurant, talk to Gianne Jnr on the of the Grand Tree. You will always want to do the hard orders. He will give you a delivery box and a name of a gnome to deliver food to.

Making the food

Gianne Jnr will tell you whether the gnome wants crunchies, a batta, a gnomebowl, or a cocktail. Click on the respective half-baked mould (obtained by using dough on the moulds, then baking) and hover over the product you need to deliver. Ingredients will be listed below, which can easily be bought from Hudo and Heckle Funch, as well as other NPC's.

Essential Ingredients

  • Equa leaves (used in baked goods and cocktails)
  • Gianne dough (the base of all baked goods)
  • Gnome spice (unlimited spice shaker)
  • Cocktail shakers (having multiple allows you to batch-create cocktails)
  • Cocktail glasses (Trollheim leprechaun sells some as well)

Pantry

  • Lemons and limes
    • Purchased through Hudo, Heckle Funch, the Grand Exchange (can be expensive), or obtained through use of the fruit bat familiar's Fruitfall special move (requiring 69 Summoning)
  • Oranges, pineapples, onions, tomatoes, cabbages, and dwellberries
    • All of these ingredients can be grown in farming patches
    • Fruit bat's Fruitfall may also produce oranges and pineapples
    • Mess Sergeant Ramsey's Cooking Supplies Shop sells tomatoes that restock fairly quickly
  • King worms and toad's legs (see following paragraph)
  • Brandy, vodka, gin, whiskey
    • Heckle Funch, along with several NPC's located in Pollvineach, City of Um, and the Lighthouse, sell these liquors
  • Cheese, pots of cream, chocolate bars, chocolate dust, and buckets of milk

Nearly all ingredients may be purchased from the Culinaromancer's Chest in Lumbridge Castle and Rodney's Independent Trading Co, located in Fort Forinthry. The only two ingredients that can not be bought (sliced and chunked fruit can be obtained by right clicking the specific fruit) are king worms and toad's legs. The quickest way to obtain these are from purchasing them from the Grand Exchange, but sometimes this can take a while. Perhaps the easiest method is to obtain the items yourself. Toad's legs can be obtained from picking up toads in the swamp area north-west of the Grand Tree and then picking off the legs. They can also be obtained quickly with a high Thieving level pickpocketing gnomes. King worms can be obtained from the same area.

A teak larder built in a player-owned house will provide an unlimited amount of buckets of milk, raw potatoes, onions, and cheese. An oak larder or wooden larder will provide an unlimited amount of milk.

It is recommended to buy the required from the Grand Exchange in bulk and use grand seed pods to return to the tree each delivery. This allows for much faster trips.

In addition to buying the prepared items, you can also create some of each item beforehand or create the item after receiving the delivery. In any case, a beast of burden familiar along with some magic notepaper may prove useful in preparing the orders as well as purchasing the ingredients.

Here are some tips if making the items on your own:

  • Be careful not to mis-click and consume your items
  • Multiple Gianne dough can be placed onto multiple cooking moulds, allowing batched preparation of pre-baked and baked goods
  • Pre-poured cocktails can be held in any number of cocktail shakers
    • Unfinished cocktails already poured in cocktail glasses may also be batch-prepped
  • "Right click to Load Last Preset" option on bank chests and an empty inventory saved with a bank preset can speed up the process of purchasing items
  • (On positioning windows to minimize click distance)
    • Position shop windows close to the bank chest when buying items
    • Position inventory close to gnome cookers when cooking

Restock with Hudo if you wish to save some on ingredients you've already banked or if you're missing a few ingredients and don't have enough space in your inventory or beast of burden.

Once deliveries are completed, the shop stocks of Hudo and Heckle Funch are replenished. This is a good time to stockpile ingredients you may need in the future.

Delivering the food

It is possible to be asked to deliver a specific food to a gnome you cannot access. For example, if you have not completed Troll Romance, you will not be able to access Brambickle. Orders can be cancelled if you cannot access the customer, but you will have to wait 5 minutes to obtain another one. You can use this time to prepare additional food or gather additional ingredients if desired.

Returning to Gianne Jnr

The simplest way to return back and get another order - assuming there are no nearby spirit trees or gnome gliders, of course - is simply using a grand seed pod, if any have been obtained. Alternatively, use a hot air balloon with one magic log if one is nearby, or use the South Feldip Hills teleport with a ring of duelling, then spirit tree to the Tree Gnome Stronghold. Go up the Grand Tree and get another order.

Alternatively, with level 8 Crafting and Level 27 Magic, a player can craft and enchant an amulet of nature and bind it to the fruit tree patch just south of The Grand Tree. This method is approximately as fast as utilising spirit trees, as the "Teleport" option on the bound amulet will transport you just 12 squares east of the Tree Gnome Stronghold spirit tree. Selling the grand seed pods rather than consuming them also significantly increases profitability; as much as 101729*60 gp more per hour. The "Teleport" option cannot be activated while a player is wearing the amulet, so one additional backpack space is needed.

Rewards

Each delivery will earn you a tip of some kind. The bulk of the money from this method comes from gnome scarves, worth 66,672,286 gp, which are only obtainable from Captain Ninto and Captain Daerkin as about a 1/20 reward. The other unique items, Gnome goggles, Grand seed pods and mint cakes, make up most of the rest of the profit, and miscellaneous runes, gems and herbs make up the rest.
m.post:
Notes

If preparing the food yourself (which would most likely be the case due to the low volume on the exchange), runs can be impacted as much as 50%.

rq.h: 75 Divination (90 Divination (recommended))

m.h:
Elder energy is usually in demand for those who want the extra Divination experience from converting memories with energy or to be used to create nightmare muspah and Nihil familiars. 75 Divination, and completion of Fate of the Gods is required to harvest elder energy. 81 Summoning for a Nightmare muspah familiar will also increase the amount of energy and sharply reduce trips to the rift for convertion, while the Divine Conversion power allows you to instantly convert an inventory of memories. Remember that in order for an enriched wisp to spawn, players must empower the rift with the elder chronicles that they collect, which grant their normal experience reward while doing so. Harvest the enriched wisp for a guaranteed supply of enriched memories. Enriched memories can be converted to twice the energy that normal memories can.

For maximum profit, convert all memories into energy (option one). Converting memories to energy produces energies at approximately 16,000 per hour with a Muspah. If better experience gain is desired, players can convert their memories into experience (option two) instead. This method yields approximately 6,000 energies per hour, 384,000 gp profit per hour, and 90,000 Divination experience per hour.

Without a Nightmare Muspah, energy per hour is down to only 14,900.

m.t: Charging empty divine charges at incandescent wisps (With Divine-o-matic vacuum)

rq.h: 101 Invention (or 95 Herblore and 84 Invention with Extreme invention)
Ring of Whispers or Luck of the Dwarves (recommended)

m.h: Invention is required to create the Divine-o-matic vacuum, but it is possible to temporarily boost the level (minimum 84) with the Extreme invention (requiring Herblore).
m.post:
Incandescent energy is in high demand by all players; being the highest levelled energy players may harvest, it requires the least amount of energy to create augmentors, and divine charges for Invention training. They are also required to create Sign of the porter VII, which are in high demand for Archaeology training.

95 Divination is required to harvest incandescent energy, but having a higher Divination level will increase the energies per hour.

Without any of the recommended equipment, approximately 8,000 energies per hour can be gathered.

Transportation

The incandescent wisps are located south of the Poison Waste. The following methods can be used to reach them:

  • The elder divination outfit colony teleport
  • The Max Guild's skill portal attuned to the Incandescent wisp colony. After attuning the portal, a grace of the elves can be used to teleport directly to the colony.
  • The fairy ring to the Lost Grove, then exit to the south.
  • The fairy ring to the Feldip Hills, south of Castle Wars, then head west.
  • The Spirit tree to the east of the Poison Waste. (requires completion of The Path of Glouphrie and a Enhanced grappling hook in the toolbelt or mithril grapple and crossbow)
Buffs and Boosts

As mentioned above, the base energies per hour is around 8,000. This can be increased by various items and methods, up to around 45,000 energies per hour. Without the dowser, around 35,000 energies can be harvested per hour.

Enriched memories give 50% more energies per memory, thus to increase our energies per hour, we could use some items and mechanics to increase our critical chance, which directly increases the number of enriched memories gathered. The following should be used if available:

  • Wearing the full elder divination outfit gives +7% chance to receive an enriched memory.
  • Nightmare muspah increases the progress to find an enriched memory by +3%.
  • Gathering from an enriched wisp increases the player's critical chance by 100%, thus guaranteeing an enriched memory.
  • Items increasing the player's divination level, such as:
    • Ring of whispers increases the player's level by 3.
    • Extreme divination potions increase the player's level by 17.

Additionally, the following increase the amount of energies gathered and converted:

  • Using a nightmare muspah gives a 5% chance to receive 4 times the energies while siphoning wisps.
  • Using a Energy-gathering scrimshaw gives a 15% chance to double the energies siphoned from wisps.
  • Wearing the full elder divination outfit gives +5% chance to quintuple the energies siphoned from wisps.
  • Having created a boon of incandescent energy permanently increases energy gain when converting memories by 10%.
  • Handing in a memory-storage bot (Cres) at the Hall of Memories permanently increases energy gain when converting memories.

Beside the critical chance, we can also increase the time siphoning enriched wisps. This can be done by gathering energies in world 79, the official community divination world, where enriched wisp are spawned frequently. This also gives the player a constant uptime of the Memory Overflow and Prism of Dowsing effects, further increasing the chance to receive an enriched memory by 20%.

Finally, we can decrease the time we spend on converting our memories:

  • The best method, using a memory dowser, doesn't have additional requirements. It gives the player +15% chance to double memories while within 2 tiles of the energy rift. Using the Divine Conversion relic in addition to the memory dowser can be useful, in cases where wisps are too far away from the incandescent energy rift.
  • The second method, making use of the Divine Conversion relic, requiring 86 Invention( b) and 98 Archaeology( b). The relic causes the player to convert all memories, in their own and the nightmare muspah's inventory, in a single action. This increases the amount of energies gathered per hour by ~50% compared to manually converting memories.
  • The third method, using a Divine-o-matic vacuum, requiring 101 Invention( b), causes gathered energies and memories to be converted to divine charges directly. Make sure to use the "Siphon energy" configuration.
Chronicle fragments and spirits

While gathering energies from wisps, chronicle fragments may spawn. These can be captured and offered at energy rifts to spawn enriched wisps. The Chronicle Attraction curse can be used to automatically capture the fragments, with an Ancient elven ritual shard to sustain prayer.

In addition to chronicle fragments, spirits may spawn if one or more of the following items are worn:

  • Seren spirits, providing additional loot from the rare drop table, if grace of the elves is worn. A luck of the dwarves can be worn to increase the value of Seren spirits.
  • Divine blessings, providing uncommon and rare Invention materials, if Brooch of the Gods is worn.
  • Catalyst of alterations, providing sealed clue scrolls, if a Scripture of Bik is worn and activated.

A spirit attraction potion can be consumed to automatically capture these spirits.

m.pg: Money making guide/High level player-owned farm run
m.h:
Black dragon eggs can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for 400,000-450,000 coins, Unchecked zygomites can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for 200,000-250,000 coins, unchecked crystal chinchompas can be bought from the Grand Exchange and can reliably be sold to other players at the adolescent stage for 70,000-90,000 coins.

The output can be other types of zygomites and chinchompas.
m.post:
These animals are removed from the pen and replaced with an egg/child/sporeling at the adolescent age due to the quantity of beans received from selling each animal to its individual NPC buyer. The quantity is highest at this age, so players looking to buy animals to exchange for beans will be more likely to buy the best return on their own investment.

In order to reduce investment costs, players may choose to spend a little extra time at the Manor Farm on a populated and/or trade dedicated world and buy "checked" versions of first stage animals from other players for a much lower price than "(unchecked)" counterparts via the Grand Exchange. Keeping in mind that once checked, farm animals do not stack in the bank. Purchasing the storm barn and subsequent extensions allows for up to 60 checked animals to be stored outside of the bank.

When selling your adolescent livestock, consider the unique qualities animals may carry (1, 2, or 3 trait slots filled? Individual traits in those slots? 'Shiny!'?) that can increase the value exponentially on the player-to-player market.

Players may also use the breeding pen to store 4 chinchompas to grow for produce, and can further improve profits by employing the breeding pen collector, which should grant approximately an additional 10 Carnivorous chinchompa (unchecked) per 42 hours; however, this won't allow you to utilise the babysitter to keep animals in this pen at their adolescence stage.

Players may also wish to not feed their animals to save on food costs, sacrificing a large portion of farming experience gained.

Employing babysitters is recommended when raising livestock to the adolescent stage. This will prevent over growing animals accidentally due to delays and/or scheduling conflicts.

m.pg: Money making guide/High level private Grenwall hunting

rq.h: 77 Hunter (99 Hunter (recommended))

m.h:
The profit rate assumes 250 catches per hour. This guide covers hunting Grenwalls at higher levels within the private hunting areas. A guide on hunting Grenwalls normally in Tirannwn can be found here. The private hunting areas are located in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, near the entrance and the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. Using the private hunting areas requires quota tickets, which can be purchased with Competence points earned from participating in Big Chinchompa.

Grenwall spikes, worth 46 coins each, are used as an ingredient for extreme ranging potions. Due to their use in Herblore, they maintain high demand. When caught, Grenwalls yield bones, between 18 and 21 Grenwall spikes, and occasionally a grimy herb.

Hunter gear does not improve the chances of catching Grenwalls successfully, however standing too close to the traps may deter the Grenwall from the trap. The Tirannwn quiver 2 from the Tirannwn tasks set will remove the need for bait, effectively increasing profits and reducing the time it takes to completely set a trap. The Arctic bear familiar gives an invisible +7 boost to Hunter, and the Scentless potion renders traps set by the player as if they have been smoked.

Using both the Tirannwn quiver 2 and the Arctic Bear familiar, it's possible to achieve over 200 catches per hour at level 85+ Hunter. With Scentless potions, the Arctic Bear familiar, and the Tirannwn quiver 2, at level 99 Hunter, it's possible to achieve 300 to 350 catches per hour.

They may also drop an assortment of grimy herbs, from ranarr to dwarf weed (excluding spirit weed, wergali, and snapdragon). It can be advantageous to bring a Bonecrusher for easy prayer experience and a herbicide for unwanted herbs.

m.pg: Money making guide/Hiring Adam Antite the tracker
m.h:
Adam Antite is a trapper farmhand who can be sent to retrieve a random unchecked animal for the player. He can be hired for 5,000 beans and requires a payment of 100 beans per usage - 212.44*100 gp. After purchase, he can be found inside the farm house. He can be sent off for a retrieval every 6 hours.

Overall sending Adam away is breakeven and can be a useful way of completing the Animal breeding log for Ironman or players not wanting to buy unchecked animals through the GE/other players.

rq.h: Lunar spells as active spellbook in order to cast Humidify

m.h:
Soft clay is often used by players training Crafting or making urns who do not have the time to collect wet clay themselves.

One can cast Humidify on an inventory of clay to turn them into soft clay. Use astral runes and equip a steam battlestaff to maximise profit and efficiency. Set up one of your "Quick Presets" to Withdraw 27 clay and an astral rune, cast the Humidify spell, which will cause the whole inventory to turn into soft clay, open the bank, Click the Quick Preset and repeat. When playing at maximum efficiency, up to 400 spells can be cast per hour, for 10,800 clay.

By utilising bank preset, it can be done even faster resulting in more money and experience/hr. By setting the runes and raw clay as a quick preset, all you have to do is click the bank, click the preset, and click the humidify spell. This significantly lowers the click amount for this method.

The method above can be accelerated even further by binding Humidify to the same key as the quick preset. Click on the banker, press '1' (or 2, if that's what you chose), then '1' again.

Alternatively, casting Humidify vials may be profitable at 259200 - 161200 - 21600 gp an hour.

rq.h: Lunar spells as active spellbook in order to cast Humidify

m.h:
Vials of water are often in high demand because they must be used with a herb in order to make an unfinished potion. Players often buy them in bulk.

One can cast Humidify on an inventory of vials. Use astral runes and equip a steam battlestaff to maximise profit and efficiency. Set up one of your "Quick Presets" to Withdraw 27 vials and an astral rune, cast the Humidify spell, which will cause the whole inventory to fill vials with water, open the bank, click the quick preset and repeat. When playing at maximum efficiency, up to 400 spells can be cast per hour, for 10,800 vials of water.

Vials have a buy limit of 10,000 every 4 hours and it is not often that they will buy for 1 coin. Decanting plenty of potions is a fast way of obtaining vials. To decant, bring as many 3 or 4 dose potions to Bob Barter and select "Decant" and select "1 dose" (make sure there are no empty vials). He will charge 2 coins for each vial. Then select the "Decant" option from him and he will turn back all the potions to "4 dose" then bank the excess vials. Repeat the same process as many times as possible. It is recommended to buy cheaper potions if you do not own plenty of potions. It is possible to profit or lose money from decanting, so be sure to pay attention to prices.

By utilising bank preset, it can be done even faster resulting in more money and experience/hr. By setting the runes and vials as a quick preset, all you have to do is click the bank, click the preset, and click the humidify spell. This significantly lowers the click amount for this method.

The method above can be accelerated even further by binding Humidify to the same key as the quick preset. Click on the banker, press '1' (or '2', if that's what you chose), then '1' again.

Alternatively, casting Humidify on clay may be profitable at 11988000 - 9180000 - 161200 gp an hour.

Azure skillchompas can be caught using box traps at the Rellekka Hunter area, which is found north-east of Rellekka. To access the area where azure skillchompas are located, climb the north-eastern most ladder in the area, then travel north-east again and climb a second ladder. Players can wear polar camo outfit or Kyatt outfit to increase their success rate in catching creatures while hunting in this area. Once trapped, azure skillchompas become stackable items, so players may hunt them for long periods of time without needing to bank.

This guide assumes 447 skillchompas are caught per hour with an approximate yield of 1.1 per trap. However, the amount caught per trap scales with Agility level; from level 81 Agility, this amount will be from 2 up to 6.

Black salamanders are in high demand as they are often used as a disposable weapon to augment then Disassemble to train Invention.

The Boneyard Hunter area is in level 18 - 20 Wilderness - Make sure to have pvp turned off by talking to Vala in Edgeville. Most teleports will work as long as you don't go into level 21. Ring of duelling or Wilderness sword 1 or greater are recommended for quick banking, the Wilderness sword 3 can teleport anywhere under 30 wilderness so is the best choice for teleporting out. TokKul-Zo is not recommended as black salamanders will be kept over it. To reach the area, the Wilderness Crater lodestone can teleport players to south of the Wilderness Crater without cost or requirements. Carrallangar Teleport brings you closer and is faster (takes ~30 seconds to reach the area from start of teleport, versus 1 minute) but requires 84 Magic and completion of Desert Treasure and costs 2 soul runes and 2 law runes.

There is a level 44 Hill Giant in the area that is aggressive to players under level 88. Green dragons are found slightly north, but are not aggressive. Turn left click attack off in combat options to avoid accidentally attacking any of them.

Small fishing nets and ropes are cheap but might not be always available on the Grand Exchange. Nicholas Angle's Fishing Shop (northeast of Taverley lodestone) and Shantay Pass Shop (south of broomstick teleport after exiting from fountain) are convenient sources of them respectively.

Checking a net trap requires you to have 3 inventory spaces - and black salamanders cannot be dropped, only released (and they will disappear immediately). Therefore, even if you drop your small fishing nets and ropes (recommended as they are worth much less than a black salamander), you can only carry 26 salamanders in your inventory. 1 can be wielded if you have 70 Ranged. Notice that even without harralander tar (which prevents you from attacking), if you click attack on a monster, it will become aggressive.
